text: Easy: What is the first step in planning a website?
explanation: The purpose of the website should be clearly identified. Developing a good website is a project similar to any other project and requires detailed planning.

text: Medium: In the Table Properties dialog box in KompoZer, what does 'Spacing' control?
choices: The space between the table and the text
The space between content and cell borders
explanation: Spacing is used to specify gap between cells. Padding gives a gap between the edge of the cell and the text within it.

text: Hard: When inserting an image in KompoZer, why is the 'Alternate text' field important?
choices: It displays text if the image cannot be loaded
It links the image to another page
explanation: Specify the alternate text in the input box otherwise select the 'Don't use alternate text' radio button. Giving alternate text will display the text in case the image is not displayed.

text: Easy: Which menu is used to insert a table in KompoZer?
explanation: Go to Insert -> Table. Select single cell table and press OK button.

text: Medium: Which tab in the Image Properties dialog allows you to change the height and width of an image?
explanation: The Image Properties dialog box (Figure 3.7) shows tabs: Location, Dimensions, Appearance, Link. Dimensions is used for Actual Size/Custom Size.

text: Hard: In the CSS Stylesheets dialog, if you want to apply a specific style only to `<h1>` tags, which option under 'New Style rule' should be selected?
choices: style applied to all elements of class
style applied to an element with specified ID
style applied to all elements of type
explanation: Click on the first radio button 'style applied to all elements of type'. In the drop down menu choose an element... h1.

text: Easy: What does CSS stand for?
explanation: Cascading Style Sheets or CSS allows you to specify styles for the visual elements of the website.

text: Medium: What is the purpose of the 'Medium' phase in website planning?
choices: To select the software to write code
To determine computer and smartphone compatibility
explanation: More and more people are using Internet through smart phones and tablets. The website design should scale for all the devices... (This falls under the Medium section).

text: Hard: In JavaScript, what does `document.js1.name.value` access?
choices: The value of the 'name' field in the 'js1' form
The value of the 'js1' field in the 'name' form
The CSS style of the name field
explanation: The term `js1` refers to the form name; `name` refers to the element name (the input field). `value` gets the content.

text: Easy: Which symbol is used to enclose a JavaScript block?
explanation: JavaScript statements can be grouped together in a block. A block starts and ends with the curly bracket { }.

text: Medium: What does the 'Borders' tab in the CSS dialog allow you to customize?
explanation: To set the border, select the Border tab. This will open the options for the border as shown... width and the color.

text: Hard: Which Java keyword is used to declare a variable that belongs to the class rather than an instance?
explanation: Class variables are defined within a class... with the static keyword. These variables are stored in the class itself.

text: Easy: What is the top-level object in the Browser Object Model (BOM)?
explanation: The top level object in the browser object model is Window object.

text: Medium: When creating a table in KompoZer, 'Width' can be specified in which two units?
explanation: Size: it shows the number of rows... Width of the table. Height and width can be specified in pixels or % of the window.

text: Hard: What does the JavaScript function `isNaN(123)` return?
explanation: `isNaN(123)` returns false as the value "123" is a number.

text: Easy: Which tag is used to embed JavaScript in an HTML file?
explanation: The <script> tag tells the browser to interpret all the text between the <script> tag as a script.

text: Medium: What does the `return false` statement do in a form validation script?
choices: It stops the function execution and prevents form submission.
explanation: This is possible by using the return statement. The use of return statement, will stop the function from executing.

text: Hard: In the CSS 'Text' tab, which option allows you to make text uppercase?
explanation: Choose 'Uppercase' from the Case menu.

text: Easy: Which KompoZer toolbar contains the 'Table' button?
explanation: Alternatively, you can click the image icon on the toolbar. (Context: Composition toolbar contains Insert/Table/Image/Form buttons).

text: Medium: In Java, which operator is used to access instance variables of an object?
explanation: Instance variables and instance methods are accessed via objects... referred by using dot (.) operator.

text: Hard: What specific JavaScript event is triggered when a user clicks the Submit button?
explanation: So, we need to use the onsubmit() event handler.

text: Easy: What does WYSIWYG stand for?
choices: What You See Is What You Get
Where You See Is Where You Go
Who You See Is Who You Get
What You Say Is What You Get
explanation: KompoZer provides a web page editor... known as WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get).

text: Medium: In CSS syntax `color : green`, what is `color`?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property associated with the HTML element... `color` is the property.

text: Hard: Which R function argument is used to specify the labels for the X-axis bars?
explanation: `names.arg` to specify the values to be displayed for the bars.

text: Easy: Which HTML tag is used for a multi-line text input?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag `<textarea>` is used.

text: Medium: In a KompoZer table, what is the function of 'Padding'?
choices: Space between text and cell border
explanation: Padding gives a gap between the edge of the cell and the text within it.

text: Hard: In Java, what is the default value of an object reference variable if not initialized?
explanation: When we only declare an object using class, the object is not created. In this case, reference variable refers to null by default.

text: Easy: Which view in Google Maps shows real-world imagery?
explanation: By clicking on the Satellite button, we may switch to the satellite image view.

text: Medium: Which function in JavaScript sets the cursor focus to a specific element?
explanation: The focus method is used to apply focus on a particular element of the form.

text: Hard: What does the 'General' tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog show?
explanation: Click on the General tab. This will show the CSS code which is generated.
